title: FAQ
intro: Quick answers about orders, shipping, returns, custom work, and caring for your handmade pieces.

items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Browse the shop, add items to your cart, and check out securely through Square. You’ll receive an order confirmation by email.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: If your order hasn’t entered production yet, email skylar@wildhouselane.com as soon as possible. Once production has started, changes may not be possible.

items.q: Will I receive a tracking number?
items.a: Yes — when your order ships, you’ll receive shipping details and tracking information by email when the carrier provides them.
Please allow up to 2–3 weeks for processing. Handmade pieces are made to order with care, and timelines can vary during busy seasons.
Orders ship using the carrier that provides the best service and value for your destination.
Yes — free shipping is available on qualifying orders over $75 within the supported shipping region.

items.q: Can I return an item if I change my mind?
items.a: Handmade items are not eligible for returns due to change of mind. Please review product details carefully before ordering.

items.q: What if my order arrives damaged or incorrect?
items.a: Please report damaged or incorrect orders within 7 days of delivery by emailing skylar@wildhouselane.com with your order number and photos.
Yes. Visit Custom Orders to share your idea, and we’ll talk materials, size, and timeline.
Custom and personalized pieces are made specifically for you and are not eligible for return unless they arrive damaged or incorrect.

items.q: Will my piece look exactly like the photos?
items.a: Each piece is handmade, so small variations in wood grain, finish, engraving, and color are part of what makes it unique. Photos are a close guide, not an identical copy.

items.q: Are your products made by you?
items.a: Yes. Wildhouse Lane goods are designed and made by Skylar, with care for materials, wildlife-inspired art, and lasting quality.

items.q: How should I care for wood charms and keychains?
items.a: Keep wood pieces dry and away from prolonged moisture or extreme heat. Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth when needed.

items.q: Can stickers and patches get wet?
items.a: Treat stickers and patches as indoor / everyday accessories unless a product page says otherwise. Avoid soaking and harsh scrubbing.

items.q: How can I get in touch?
items.a: Email skylar@wildhouselane.com or visit the Contact page for social links.

items.q: Where can I read your policies?
items.a: See Shipping & Returns, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Service.
